plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5%/month return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration, but also limits upside potential.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 1% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.
Reduce SPY to 25% to meet the concentration mandate.
Buy CRWV, targeting 4% of the book, as a new high-scoring setup.
Trim CRWD to 10% to reduce single-name concentration.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining a small leveraged component.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for ~2.5%/month growth by managing risk while seeking opportunities. It reduces leverage and concentration, offering a more stable growth profile with moderate drawdown potential.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the concentration mandate.
Reduce SMH to 10% as it is flagged for trimming.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month growth by leveraging high-conviction setups. It carries significantly higher risk, including larger potential drawdowns and the daily decay/rebalancing effects of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETFs.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Add to QQQI, targeting 30% of the book, to prioritize income generation.

income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month, prioritizing steady distributions and low drawdown. While aiming for cash-like income, distributions are variable, and NAV can still decline in market selloffs. Growth potential is minimal.
